events.title: Fortran 95 standard published (ISO/IEC 1539-1:1997)
events.summary: ISO/IEC 1539-1:1997 was published in December 1997 — the Fortran 95 standard with pure functions and elemental operations.
events.about: Fortran 95 refined Fortran 90 with `PURE`/`ELEMENTAL` procedures, better array features, and the `FORALL` construct. It is the dialect many legacy HPC codes target. High-performance libraries (BLAS, LAPACK interfaces) commonly assume F95 semantics.

narrative.whyChosen: Fortran 95 is the stable baseline many compilers and numerical libraries standardized on before Fortran 2003.
narrative.whyImportant: Pure and elemental procedures made parallel and optimizing compilers more effective on scientific loops.
narrative.problemSolved: Fortran 90 left gaps for side-effect-free functions and whole-array intrinsics that optimizing compilers needed.
